title: Consistency Training while Mitigating Obfuscation via Rate Matching

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to multiple-choice questions (from LogiQA, HellaSwag, and HLE) across six types of prompt-level perturbations designed to influence the model toward an incorrect answer: suggested answer, distractor fact, distractor argument, post hoc exchange, spurious few-shot symbols, and wrong few-shot labeling. The paper measures the 'towards-bias switch rate' (BSR←), quantifying how often the model shifts from a correct answer to a biased one when a cue is introduced.
